diagnostics.rayMethod: finite source candidate filtering plus authored and hosted analytic domains
diagnostics.metric: source BVH visits + authored and hosted finite-domain candidate tests
diagnostics.stepCapKind: finite query count, not a march budget
diagnostics.hitEpsilon: source finite-plane residual <0.00002m; hosted exact rounded-rectangle interval predicates with Float32 tolerance
diagnostics.stepRule: retain only selected patch masks; continue source traversal after rejected candidates; analytic hosted interval endpoints, no ray marching
diagnostics.missCondition: all finite source, authored and hosted candidates rejected

scheduling.mode: on-demand latest-state coalescing; no animation loop or frame-rate claim
scheduling.timingMeaning: requestToDispatchStartMs is latest request to JavaScript dispatch start; dispatchWallMs is synchronous callback wall time, sometimes including driver work. Neither measures isolated GPU time or visible presentation latency.

gpuBackpressure.method: non-blocking WebGL2 fence; latest camera replaces queued intent; no GPU or presentation latency claim

frame.completion: latest requested atomic screen frame submitted and WebGL fence observed complete; not presentation latency
